missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Боец' is the masculine nominative subject. Note the fleeting vowel: it disappears in other cases. 'Смелый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative of animate noun. 'Бойца' takes the genitive-like form because the fighter is animate masculine. The fleeting vowel drops, and 'молодого' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Бойца' is the genitive after 'нет', with the fleeting vowel dropped. 'Опытного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after verb. 'Бойцу' is the dative required by 'доверять'. The fleeting vowel drops, and 'этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Бойцом' is the instrumental required by 'гордиться'. The fleeting vowel drops, and 'своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Бойце' is the prepositional form after 'в', with the fleeting vowel dropped. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Бойцы' is the nominative plural subject of 'защищают'. The fleeting vowel drops in the plural too, and 'сильные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate noun. 'Бойцов' takes the genitive plural form because the fighters are animate. 'Храбрых' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Бойцах' is the prepositional plural after 'о', the topic of the story. The fleeting vowel drops in this form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Бойцов' is the genitive plural governed by 'без', expressing the lack of fighters. 'Крепость' is the accusative object.
